    Sources and assumptions

    Game data comes from MwoLab (kmonkeyhead.github.io/mwolab), which extracts it from MWO’s own game files. Snapshot: 28 Oct 2026. The build code reader and several formulas are MwoLab’s.

    • Heat sinks, weapons, quirks, omnipods and skill node values are read straight from that data. Nothing is typed in by hand.
    • Heat capacity = 30 × (1 + capacity bonus) + engine sinks × engine capacity + external sinks × external capacity × (1 + capacity bonus). Up to 10 sinks count as engine sinks. This is MwoLab’s formula, and it reproduces MechDB’s numbers. Whether Heat Containment scales the engine-sink part in the real game is still unconfirmed.
    • Dissipation = (engine sinks × engine cooling + external sinks × cooling) × (1 + dissipation bonus).
    • Quirks and skill nodes with the same effect are added together, then applied once. This matches MwoLab.
    • Ghost heat uses each weapon’s penalty, threshold and group from the data, and MwoLab’s escalation curve. Shots from the same group within 0.5 s count together; that window is documented by players, not by the data. Ghost heat uses base heat, before heat reduction.
    • Laser heat is applied evenly across the beam duration, starting after any charge time. Every other weapon adds its heat the moment it fires. Cooldown starts when the beam ends. Shutdown happens at 100% heat.
    • Not modeled: Ultra AC double-tap and jams, flamers, machine guns, rotary ACs, one-shot launchers, jump jet heat and coolant flush.
